sourceAttempts.result: Documents the three-mile spring-fed run through Ichetucknee Springs State Park, the North canoe launch, Dampier’s Landing at mile 2.25, the three-mile south take-out and the hard boundary before downstream Santa Fe water; the final segment is labeled approximately one river mile for coordinate-audit conservatism.

sourceAttempts.method: Current canoe/kayak access and entrance rules
sourceAttempts.result: Confirms non-motorized North launch access, 3 p.m. launch cutoff, 6 p.m. river-clear requirement, capacity controls and seasonal shuttle/carry posture.
Publishes Ichetucknee USGS 02322700 flow values directly: 246 cfs at 95-percent exceedance and 343 cfs at 50-percent exceedance, used as conservative floor and preferred reference.
USGS 02322700 at Highway 27 has current discharge telemetry and is operated with Florida DEP and Suwannee River Water Management District cooperation.

sourceAttempts.method: North launch, Dampier’s Landing and South Takeout map anchors plus NHD endpoint audit
sourceAttempts.result: All six endpoints are public-park access anchors and audit within the mapped Ichetucknee waterbody/flowline.

sourceAttempts.method: Spring-run traffic, cold water, park-hour and downstream-boundary review
sourceAttempts.result: All three segments are easy but remain caution-level for cold water, swimmers/tubers, wood, storms, capacity and the mandatory state-park take-out.
